entries.base_behavior: Single global raw block; another symbol finalizes it; eligibility needs >=300s with cross_symbol_interruption_count=0; shadow gate requires PairAdmission outcomes identical to the old path.
entries.amended_behavior: Per-symbol isolated raw admission lineage (5scr.pair-admission.per-symbol-isolated.v3) over an explicit universe; other symbols never interrupt; global safety is an overlay; legacy raw-ledger.v2 replayable; shadow gate records per-symbol divergence instead of requiring identity.
entries.reason: Automatic per-pair canonical qualification across 30 pairs; the global FSM lets activity on one symbol finalize every other symbol's admission.

entries.base_behavior: Opposite direction requires a new hypothesis; the fate of the old active hypothesis is undefined.
entries.amended_behavior: One active hypothesis per lifecycle; a pressure-level flip marks the old one INVALIDATED (OPPOSITE_DIRECTION_SUPERSEDED), append-only, CAS active pointer.
entries.reason: Deterministic single-active hypothesis without rewriting history.

entries.base_behavior: Context epoch expires; re-opening with identical material is undefined.
entries.amended_behavior: No new epoch and no revival (EPOCH_EXPIRED_MATERIAL_UNCHANGED, fail closed); only a material change opens a new epoch.
entries.reason: Telemetry refresh must not extend or revive a clock (§18).

entries.base_behavior: DEFER is a legal context outcome; proof promotion under DEFER is undefined.
entries.amended_behavior: No structural proof promotion under DEFER (CONTEXT_DEFERRED_NO_PROOF_PROMOTION).
entries.reason: Deferred context is not a route-permitting context.

entries.base_behavior: Thesis only if proof is available (§14.1) vs PENDING_H1/PENDING_M15 states (§14.2/§28.16).
entries.amended_behavior: Evidence may precede the thesis; birth at PENDING_H1 on ALIGN + active same-direction hypothesis; atomic proof binding -> STRUCTURALLY_CONFIRMED; PENDING_M15 reserved; PENDING_CONTEXT/DORMANT unreachable; direction authority derived from state, never execution authority.
entries.reason: Resolves the internal §14.1/§28.16 tension without a thesis that holds unearned authority.

entries.base_behavior: No thesis clock is listed although EXPIRED and 'thesis expiry' exist.
entries.amended_behavior: Hashed versioned thesis clock, no default TTL; valid_until = min(valid_from + ttl, context_epoch.valid_until) with explicit valid_until_bound; immutable; expiry terminal.
entries.reason: A thesis may not stay actionable beyond its context epoch.

entries.base_behavior: Ordering is defined; invalidation by later closed candles before binding is undefined.
entries.amended_behavior: Binding requires a hashed actionability policy: contiguous closed H1/M15 coverage through decision time, no later adjacent counter-H1 break, no later M15 close back through the break level; missing coverage fails closed; proof record never edited.
entries.reason: Immutable evidence may still be non-actionable; derived from V1 thesis liveness predicates.

entries.base_behavior: Terminal thesis states and reason codes exist; triggers and concurrency are undefined.
entries.amended_behavior: Epoch superseded -> SUPERSEDED; epoch expired -> EXPIRED; structural invalidation of a confirmed thesis -> INVALIDATED; at most one active thesis per lifecycle (CAS); terminal never revived.

entries.base_behavior: Section 8.5 defines the window start per admission class and section 16.2 declares ended_at nullable; nothing defines closure, reopening or late evidence.
entries.amended_behavior: Window start restated per class with a coverage_anchor_rule derivation label; as-of bound observed_through_utc forbids future observations. NORMATIVE closure authority (owner 2026-09-21): the MarketEpisode close is the sole closure authority; lifecycle supersession does not close the window; raw-block termination alone does not close the window; reopening a closed canonical range is false. Late evidence is appended while open and rejected as a permanent gap after closure.
entries.reason: ended_at determines the evidence window and therefore source_price_ids, the low/high universe, coverage and evidence_hash.

entries.base_behavior: Audit/Replay v3 section 11 step 5 constrains when an observation may count (no future price) but never how low and high are derived or which prices qualify.
entries.amended_behavior: QualifyingPressurePriceObservation defined first: authoritative closed M1 candle of the canonical symbol, not UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE/QUARANTINED, close_time <= observed_through_utc, inside the window, deduplicated by evidence id with conflicting duplicates becoming a gap, and period-aligned so that every source_price_ids entry resolves to exactly one canonical period (G2/G6 cardinality consistency). Then low = min(low) and high = max(high) over wicks; zero qualifying observations give null bounds and MISSING coverage; policy inputs are versioned hashed policy with no defaults.
entries.reason: Without the qualifying universe, min/max is ambiguous and the geometry is not replayable.

entries.base_behavior: Section 16.2 fixes four coverage values and section 8.5 fixes the consequence of incomplete coverage; nothing defines what selects a value.
entries.amended_behavior: Threshold-free set completeness against the provider calendar: QUARANTINED > MISSING > PARTIAL > COMPLETE. No percentage is introduced. Coverage is computed per canonical period and is undecidable (rejected, never defaulted) without the period-aligned cardinality of A1-10. Only COMPLETE permits structural_authority true; the others place the lifecycle in WAITING_PRICE_COVERAGE. Vocabulary is closed: DEGRADED and UNAVAILABLE are not introduced and STALE stays on the observation and feed axes.
entries.reason: Coverage decides actionability; an arbitrary ratio would silently move the boundary between analysable and non-analysable lineages.

entries.base_behavior: Section 15.1 names ExecutionBox material revision and section 15.2 forbids duplicate telemetry from creating a new box version; PressureRange is named in neither, so it has no refresh-versus-material rule.
entries.amended_behavior: Three classes over a normative field partition: MATERIAL_RANGE_CHANGE (geometry-material fields), COVERAGE_CHANGE (coverage fields with identical geometry), EVIDENCE_REFRESH (evidence fields only), and no class for non-material-only differences. Coverage may change while low and high are identical and that re-evaluates lifecycle actionability. COVERAGE_CHANGE does not by itself imply an ExecutionBox revision; that is G7 and belongs to 12C.
entries.reason: Without the partition every authoritative close would cascade range to target to box supersede to lifecycle churn.

ratification.method: independent byte verification by the owner (Get-FileHash + git rev-parse)
